contract: Local social account registry with normalized stable platform identity, person linkage, credential references, optimistic revisions, idempotency and durable history; native tools and actual Console review.
acceptance: Persistent normalized identity uniqueness and replay across restart
Person references, unknown fields and malformed profile links rejected
Revision guarded edit, archive and local removal with retained provenance
Actual native tools and HTTP Console create/edit/history/remove workflow
limits: Registry metadata only; no external ownership, account creation, verification, connectivity, ingestion or publishing is claimed.
Shared native-tool, route and Page mounts are retained as integration evidence and excluded from task ownership because later communications slices extend those files.
acceptance_coverage: Persistent NFKC/casefolded platform-handle identity is unique per platform, idempotent by request key and survives store reopen.
Strict fields, HTTPS profile metadata, named credential references and canonical person IDs reject malformed or unknown input atomically.
Optimistic edits, archive state and local-only removal retain immutable event history and never claim or mutate an external account.
Actual HTTP, approval-gated native tools and the real console server execute register, edit, archive, history, stale conflict, reopen and local removal journeys.
